about: The reference board: the fx stage's strips (scripts/fx.sh, the fx skill), one effect over a dark and a light card, every frame of it, measured against the plate and the last run, beside references and the operator's marks. node scripts/board.mjs look shoots every view and draws the sheet; it scores nothing. A reference that is not ours or CC0 stays out of the repo: mark it private and keep it in $ELO_REF_DIR.

views.name: Effect: a beam rifle's shot striking
views.what: a beam rifle's shot striking a suit on the fx stage: dark card left, light card right
views.take: a hard white-hot flash and sparks thrown off the armour, gone fast; reads at mech scale against black space

views.name: Effect: machine-cannon rounds striking
views.what: a machine cannon's round striking on the fx stage
views.take: smaller and duller than a beam's: ballistic sparks and a puff, so a burst reads as many small hits

views.name: Effect: the Heavy Beam Rifle firing
views.what: the Heavy Beam Rifle's muzzle on the fx stage
views.take: the biggest muzzle in the game: a white core blooming to colour, a ring, gone in a breath

views.name: Effect: beam sabers meeting
views.what: beam sabers clashing on the fx stage
views.take: a burst of sparks and light where the blades meet, anime-bright, the sparks thrown wide

views.name: Effect: a suit destroyed
views.what: a suit's death on the fx stage, framed for 40 m
views.take: a flash, a fireball that cools, debris and smoke hanging in vacuum (no gravity, no drag); the light card shows the smoke's body

views.name: Effect: a missile's warhead
views.what: a missile bursting on the fx stage
views.take: a sharp flash and a ball of fire smaller than a kill's, smoke after

views.name: Effect: a rock shattering
views.what: a rock breaking on the fx stage, its ore's colour in the dust
views.take: chunks and a cloud of dust in the ore's colour flying outward and drifting on in vacuum
